variants.headline: Looking back: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.

An inability to pay is a credit event, but it is not a complete balance sheet. Business readers should avoid guessing the exposure of a creditor or the terms of a restructuring. The disciplined approach separates the known failure from a recovery calculation for which this report supplies no figures.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} requires scrutiny against the inability to pay. This paper does not presume the origin of the debts or announce a response that the financial report has not established.
